title: 12V DC Car Power Adapter Charger with 5.5mm x 2.1mm Tip Plug Connector
categoryName: Consumer Electronics:Vehicle Electronics & GPS:Car Electronics Accessories:Adapters
descriptionText:
This 12V DC car power adapter charger is perfect for those who need to charge their devices while on the go. With a 5.5mm x 2.1mm tip plug connector, it can easily connect to your car's cigarette lighter socket and provide a reliable source of power. 

Commonly known as a car cigarette lighter adapter. It has a plug that fits into the 12V outlet (or cigarette lighter socket) in a vehicle, providing power to the connected device. This adapter has a 12V output at 3A, which is typically used to power small electronic devices, such as portable air pumps, small fans, or charging units.

The other end of this adapter has a barrel plug, which connects to compatible devices that require a 12V DC input.
